requirements.title: Broker Management
requirements.source_requirement_text: Maintain the brokerage, producer, institution relationship, contacts, and responsible underwriter. Demonstrate opening an institution from its broker and showing the same relationship on its submission and policy. Acceptance: a broker user sees authorized institutions only; changing the servicing relationship preserves history. UE must supply the authority, appointment, licensing, and brokerage hierarchy rules that apply to the property program.
requirements.source_acceptance_condition: a broker user sees authorized institutions only; changing the servicing relationship preserves history.
requirements.expected_behavior: Broker, institution, producer and responsible underwriter remain linked across submission and policy; authorized institutions only; servicing changes preserve history.

requirements.source_requirement_text: Accept the supplied PDF and spreadsheet package, retain originals, classify document types, and map institution and location data with source references. Demonstrate a missing item and a discrepancy before review completion. Acceptance: extraction produces reviewable values with document and page or sheet/cell references; repeat intake avoids duplicate business records; conflicting values remain visible. The source corpus includes scanned forms, multi-sheet workbooks, current exposure schedules, and older policy specimens.

Demonstrate an underwriter resolving a discrepancy with an explanation and recording a decision. Acceptance: only an authorized person can approve a referred case, and the application records the previous value, new value, reviewer, time, and reason. The authority matrix and appetite rules remain customer inputs.

Acceptance: known reference cases reproduce UE-approved premiums and factors; missing required fields or failed rating responses prevent an apparently valid quote. Any illustrative rate used in the demo must be visibly identified as a demo assumption.

requirements.title: Quote Management

Demonstrate selecting one version. Acceptance: subsequent edits create a new version or explicitly controlled change, and the bind action uses the selected approved version. Expired, withdrawn, or superseded options cannot bind through an unnoticed stale state.

requirements.title: Endorsements

Acceptance: the prior policy remains reconstructable; the adjusted period, premium, receivable, and commission agree. Out-of-sequence changes and overlapping effective dates require explicit behavior.

requirements.title: Commission Tracking and Broker Commissions

source_anchor.section: R12 Commission Tracking and Broker Commissions

requirements.source_requirement_text: Apply an approved broker agreement to the correct premium base and transaction, keeping earned, payable, paid, and reversed amounts distinct. Demonstrate a new-business accrual and an endorsement or cancellation adjustment. Acceptance: a transaction does not create duplicate commission; rates and bases remain explainable; reversals reconcile to the original. Agreements, splits, timing, tax treatment, and exception authority need confirmation.
requirements.source_acceptance_condition: a transaction does not create duplicate commission; rates and bases remain explainable; reversals reconcile to the original.
requirements.expected_behavior: Explain approved commission base/rate/agreement per transaction; distinguish earned, payable, paid and reversed; new-business and endorsement/cancel adjustment do not duplicate commission.

requirements.title: Billing and Receivables
requirements.source_requirement_text: Connect policy transactions to invoices, installments, receipts, allocations, credits, refunds, and outstanding balances. Demonstrate an invoice, a partial payment, and an aged balance using synthetic amounts. Acceptance: the balance equals charges less applied receipts and credits; unmatched money remains unapplied; refund status distinguishes calculated, approved, and paid. Confirm direct versus agency bill, payment service, bank or ledger interfaces, currency, and reconciliation cadence.

requirements.expected_behavior: Synthetic invoice, partial receipt and aged receivable link to policy; charges minus applied receipts/credits reconcile, unmatched money stays unapplied, and calculated/approved/paid refunds differ.
